environment.description: Container deployed on EKS 1.29 with Pod Security Admission enforcing 'restricted' profile. SecurityContext specifies drop ALL capabilities then adds only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. The node group uses a custom AMI with iptables PREROUTING chain rule that DNAT-redirects all outbound traffic from pod CIDR destined to link-local range (169.254.0.0/16) to a blackhole interface (lo with port unreachable). Additionally, the VPC subnet has a local route table entry for 169.254.169.254/32 with target 'blackhole' applied via AWS CDK NetworkFirewall stateful rule group with action DROP for any traffic matching destination 169.254.0.0/16 from the pod subnet CIDR. Node IMDS is configured with HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1 and HttpTokens=required (IMDSv2), though this is noted as defense-in-depth since network-level blocking is primary.

config.network_firewall_rule: stateful rule: drop ip 10.0.0.0/16 any -> 169.254.0.0/16 any (msg:"block metadata"; sid:1000001; rev:1;)
config.calico_network_policy: deny egress to 169.254.0.0/16 for namespace webhook-service
